name: Case Sensitive User Login
description: Adds a login validator requiring the entered username to match the stored username's case exactly. Purely restrictive; effectiveness depends on the DB collation being case-sensitive.
project_description:
This module change drupal login username to case-sensitive.

 Drupal 10 login is case in-sensitive. Means you can login to drupal using user name 'admin' ,'Admin', 'ADMIN' etc.

 This module make username is case sensitive. So if your username is 'admin' then you can not login with 'Admin'

 This module only affects the login form and does not change other core functionality of Drupal, including password reset, API logins, etc

 Just install this module. No other configuration required.
